name: The Change
source:
Zack is the classic example of a person who dislikes communication. His life changes when a new girl from the countryside transfers to his school. Suddenly, his normal routine of a peaceful walk home from school is invaded with prying questions and unwanted attention of his life. Will his outlook on life change when he meets the bubbly, idealistic Bell?

A short story about life and humanity. (Sort of)

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31370]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
扎克是典型的沟通障碍者，不喜欢与人交流。当一个来自乡下的新女孩转学到他的学校后，他的人生发生了改变。原本平静的放学回家日常，突然被她的追问和对他生活的过度关注打乱。当他遇到活泼又理想主义的贝尔后，他对人生的看法会改变吗？

这是一个关于生活与人性的短篇故事。（大概吧。）

[摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31370]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
